SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_invoice_amount FROM Invoice;

FROM Track;

SELECT
    g.Name AS genre_name,
    COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
FROM
    Genre g
LEFT JOIN
    Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY
    g.Name
ORDER BY
    genre_name;

SELECT a.Name
FROM Artist a
JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

```sql
SELECT 
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName,
    SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
SELECT
    BillingCountry AS country,
    SUM(Total) AS revenue
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY BillingCountry
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

SELECT
    EXTRACT(year FROM InvoiceDate) AS year,
    SUM(Total) AS total_revenue
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT a.Title
FROM Album a
JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC';

SELECT t.Name
FROM Track t
JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock';

SELECT
    mt.Name AS MediaTypeName,
    COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM
    Track t
JOIN
    MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY
    mt.Name
ORDER BY
    mt.Name;

SELECT
    BillingCountry,
    AVG(Total) AS AvgInvoiceTotal
FROM
    Invoice
GROUP BY
    BillingCountry
ORDER BY
    BillingCountry;

SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName
FROM Employee e
JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId
WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards';

SELECT 
    e.FirstName,
    e.LastName,
    COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS NumCustomers
FROM Employee e
LEFT JOIN Customer c
    ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName
ORDER BY e.LastName, e.FirstName;

SELECT p.PlaylistId AS id, p.Name AS name
FROM Playlist p
JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000;

SELECT
    g.Name AS genre_name,
    AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_price
FROM
    Track t
JOIN
    Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY
    g.Name
ORDER BY
    g.Name;

SELECT Composer
FROM Track
WHERE Composer IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Composer
HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;

```sql
SELECT
    g.Name AS genre_name,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.Name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT
    ar.Name AS artist_name,
    SUM(il.Quantity) AS tracks_sold
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
GROUP BY ar.Name
ORDER BY tracks_sold DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz';

```sql
SELECT 
    e.FirstName,
    e.LastName,
    COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS Revenue
FROM Employee e
LEFT JOIN Customer c
    ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
LEFT JOIN Invoice i
    ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName
ORDER BY Revenue DESC;
```

SELECT COUNT(*) AS unsold_track_count
FROM Track t
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
WHERE il.TrackId IS NULL;

SELECT
    a.Title AS album_title,
    ROUND(SUM(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS length_minutes
FROM Album a
JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title
ORDER BY length_minutes DESC
LIMIT 5;

```sql
SELECT
    ar.ArtistId,
    ar.Name AS ArtistName,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.GenreId) AS GenreCount
FROM
    Track t
    JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
    JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY
    ar.ArtistId,
    ar.Name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.GenreId) > 1;
```

SELECT FirstName, LastName, HireDate
FROM Employee
ORDER BY HireDate ASC
LIMIT 1;

```sql
SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName
FROM   Customer c
JOIN   (
         SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS CustomerTotal
         FROM   Invoice
         GROUP BY CustomerId
       ) ic ON ic.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE  ic.CustomerTotal > (
         SELECT AVG(CustomerTotal)
         FROM   (
                 SELECT SUM(Total) AS CustomerTotal
                 FROM   Invoice
                 GROUP BY CustomerId
               ) sub
       );
```

```sql
SELECT
    year,
    genre_name,
    quantity_sold
FROM (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(year FROM i.InvoiceDate) AS year,
        g.Name AS genre_name,
        SUM(il.Quantity) AS quantity_sold,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(year FROM i.InvoiceDate) ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC) AS rnk
    FROM Invoice i
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    GROUP BY year, genre_name
) sub
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY year;
```

```sql
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', InvoiceDate) AS month,
    SUM(Total) AS revenue,
    SUM(Total) - LAG(SUM(Total)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', InvoiceDate)) AS change_from_previous_month
FROM Invoice
WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM InvoiceDate) = 2025
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', InvoiceDate)
ORDER BY month;
```

```sql
SELECT
    mt.Name AS MediaType,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) / SUM(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity)) OVER (), 2) AS Percentage
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY mt.Name
ORDER BY Percentage DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName
FROM
    Customer c
JOIN
    Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
WHERE
    EXTRACT(year FROM i.InvoiceDate) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
GROUP BY
    c.CustomerId,
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(year FROM i.InvoiceDate)) = 5;
```

SELECT
    ar.Name AS artist_name,
    ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS avg_minutes
FROM Track t
JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) >= 10
ORDER BY avg_minutes DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    e.FirstName AS EmployeeFirstName,
    e.LastName AS EmployeeLastName,
    m.FirstName AS ManagerFirstName,
    m.LastName AS ManagerLastName
FROM Employee e
LEFT JOIN Employee m
    ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId;

```sql
SELECT
    month,
    SUM(monthly_total) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total
FROM (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', InvoiceDate) AS month,
        SUM(Total) AS monthly_total
    FROM Invoice
    WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM InvoiceDate) = 2022
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', InvoiceDate)
) t
ORDER BY month;
```

SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name
FROM Playlist AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM PlaylistTrack pt
    WHERE pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM countries;

```sql
SELECT
    c.name,
    cs.population
FROM country_stats cs
JOIN countries c USING (iso3)
WHERE cs.year = 2023
ORDER BY cs.population DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

```sql
SELECT
    income_group,
    COUNT(DISTINCT iso3) AS country_count
FROM countries
GROUP BY income_group
ORDER BY country_count DESC;
```

SELECT c.name
FROM countries c
JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3
WHERE cs.year = 2023
ORDER BY cs.gdp_per_capita_usd DESC
LIMIT 1;

```sql
SELECT
    year,
    SUM(population) AS combined_population
FROM country_stats
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;
```

```sql
SELECT c.iso3,
       c.name,
       cs.life_expectancy_years
FROM   countries AS c
JOIN   country_stats AS cs
       ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3
WHERE  c.region = 'Sub-Saharan Africa'
  AND  cs.year = 2023
  AND  cs.life_expectancy_years > 70
ORDER BY cs.life_expectancy_years DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT
    cs.year,
    cs.unemployment_pct AS unemployment_rate
FROM country_stats cs
JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3 = c.iso3
WHERE c.name = 'Germany'
  AND cs.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2023
ORDER BY cs.year;
```

```sql
SELECT
    cs.region,
    AVG(cs.fertility_rate) AS avg_fertility_rate_2023
FROM
    country_stats AS cs
JOIN
    countries AS c
ON
    cs.iso3 = c.iso3
WHERE
    cs.year = 2023
GROUP BY
    cs.region
ORDER BY
    cs.region;
```

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.iso3) AS countries_with_gdp_over_1trillion
FROM country_stats cs
WHERE cs.year = 2023
  AND cs.gdp_usd > 1000000000000;

```sql
SELECT c.name AS country,
       cs.fertility_rate
FROM   countries c
JOIN   country_stats cs
       ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3
WHERE  c.region = 'Europe & Central Asia'
  AND  cs.year = 2023
ORDER BY cs.fertility_rate ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

SELECT year, gdp_usd
FROM country_stats
WHERE iso3 = 'USA' AND year IN (2000, 2023)
ORDER BY year;

```sql
SELECT
    c.region,
    AVG(cs.internet_users_pct) AS avg_internet_usage_pct
FROM
    country_stats cs
JOIN
    countries c
ON
    cs.iso3 = c.iso3
WHERE
    cs.year = 2023
GROUP BY
    c.region
HAVING
    AVG(cs.internet_users_pct) > 70;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN population END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2000 THEN population END) AS population_growth
FROM country_stats
WHERE iso3 = 'CHN' 
  AND year IN (2000, 2023);
```

```sql
SELECT
    c.name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cs.year = 2023 THEN cs.life_expectancy_years END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN cs.year = 2000 THEN cs.life_expectancy_years END) AS life_expectancy_gain
FROM country_stats cs
JOIN countries c USING (iso3)
WHERE cs.year IN (2000, 2023)
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING 
    MAX(CASE WHEN cs.year = 2000 THEN cs.life_expectancy_years END) IS NOT NULL
    AND MAX(CASE WHEN cs.year = 2023 THEN cs.life_expectancy_years END) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY life_expectancy_gain DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

```sql
SELECT
    cs.income_group,
    SUM(cs.gdp_usd) AS total_gdp_2023
FROM country_stats cs
WHERE cs.year = 2023
GROUP BY cs.income_group
ORDER BY total_gdp_2023 DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT
    cs.iso3,
    c.name,
    c.region,
    cs.gdp_per_capita_usd
FROM
    country_stats AS cs
JOIN
    countries AS c
    ON cs.iso3 = c.iso3
WHERE
    cs.year = 2023
    AND cs.gdp_per_capita_usd > (
        SELECT AVG(cs2.gdp_per_capita_usd)
        FROM country_stats AS cs2
        JOIN countries AS c2 ON cs2.iso3 = c2.iso3
        WHERE cs2.year = 2023
          AND c2.region = c.region
    );
```

SELECT
    SUM(cs.population * cs.life_expectancy_years) / SUM(cs.population) AS population_weighted_life_expectancy_2023
FROM
    country_stats cs
WHERE
    cs.year = 2023
    AND cs.population IS NOT NULL
    AND cs.life_expectancy_years IS NOT NULL;

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS countries_with_decreasing_population
FROM (
    SELECT c.iso3,
           MAX(CASE WHEN cs.year = 2010 THEN cs.population END) AS pop_2010,
           MAX(CASE WHEN cs.year = 2023 THEN cs.population END) AS pop_2023
    FROM country_stats cs
    JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3
    WHERE cs.year IN (2010, 2023)
    GROUP BY c.iso3
    HAVING pop_2010 IS NOT NULL
       AND pop_2023 IS NOT NULL
       AND pop_2023 < pop_2010
) sub;
```

SELECT c.name,
       c.region,
       cs.life_expectancy_years
FROM   country_stats cs
JOIN   countries c USING (iso3)
WHERE  cs.year = 2023
  AND  cs.life_expectancy_years < 60;

```sql
SELECT
    cs.region,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cs.population) / SUM(SUM(cs.population)) OVER (), 2) AS population_share_pct
FROM country_stats cs
JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3 = c.iso3
WHERE cs.year = 2023
GROUP BY cs.region
ORDER BY population_share_pct DESC;
```

SELECT c.iso3, c.name
FROM countries AS c
LEFT JOIN country_stats AS cs
  ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3
  AND cs.year = 2023
  AND cs.gdp_usd IS NOT NULL
WHERE cs.iso3 IS NULL;

```sql
SELECT
    cs.year,
    CASE 
        WHEN LAG(cs.gdp_usd) OVER (ORDER BY cs.year) IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE 100.0 * (cs.gdp_usd - LAG(cs.gdp_usd) OVER (ORDER BY cs.year)) 
                     / LAG(cs.gdp_usd) OVER (ORDER BY cs.year)
    END AS gdp_growth_pct
FROM country_stats cs
JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3 = c.iso3
WHERE c.name = 'France'
ORDER BY cs.year;
```

SELECT
    c.income_group,
    c.name,
    cs.gdp_per_capita_usd
FROM country_stats cs
JOIN countries c USING (iso3)
WHERE cs.year = 2023
QUALIFY cs.gdp_per_capita_usd = MAX(cs.gdp_per_capita_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY c.income_group);

```sql
SELECT
    c.region,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cs.urban_population_pct) AS median_urban_population_pct
FROM country_stats AS cs
JOIN countries AS c USING (iso3)
WHERE cs.year = 2023
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY median_urban_population_pct DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    c.iso3,
    c.name
FROM 
    country_stats cs2010
JOIN 
    country_stats cs2023
    ON cs2010.iso3 = cs2023.iso3
JOIN 
    countries c
    ON c.iso3 = cs2010.iso3
WHERE 
    cs2010.year = 2010
    AND cs2023.year = 2023
    AND cs2010.internet_users_pct < 10
    AND cs2023.internet_users_pct > 50;
```

```sql
SELECT
    CORR(cs.gdp_per_capita_usd, cs.life_expectancy_years) AS gdp_per_capita_life_expectancy_corr
FROM
    country_stats cs
WHERE
    cs.year = 2023;
```

```sql
SELECT
    cs.region,
    c.name,
    cs.population
FROM (
    SELECT
        iso3,
        year,
        population,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY population DESC) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cs.iso3,
            cs.year,
            cs.population,
            c.region
        FROM country_stats cs
        JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3 = c.iso3
        WHERE cs.year = 2023
    ) sub
) cs
JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3 = c.iso3
WHERE cs.rn <= 3
ORDER BY cs.region, cs.rn;
```

```sql
SELECT
    cs.region,
    c.name AS country,
    cs.unemployment_pct AS unemployment_rate
FROM (
    SELECT
        iso3,
        region,
        unemployment_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY unemployment_pct DESC) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cs.iso3,
            c.region,
            cs.unemployment_pct
        FROM country_stats cs
        JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3 = c.iso3
        WHERE cs.year = 2020
    ) sub
) cs
JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3 = c.iso3
WHERE cs.rn = 1
ORDER BY cs.region;
```

```sql
SELECT
    region,
    year,
    avg_life_expectancy
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.region,
        cs.year,
        AVG(cs.life_expectancy_years) AS avg_life_expectancy,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region ORDER BY AVG(cs.life_expectancy_years) DESC) AS rn
    FROM country_stats cs
    JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3 = c.iso3
    GROUP BY c.region, cs.year
) sub
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region;
```
SELECT COUNT(*) AS penguin_count FROM penguins;
SELECT DISTINCT island FROM penguins;

SELECT MAX(body_mass_g) AS heaviest_body_mass_g
FROM penguins;

SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) AS average_flipper_length_mm
FROM penguins;

SELECT
    species,
    AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass_g
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species;

```sql
SELECT
    island,
    year,
    COUNT(*) AS penguin_count
FROM penguins
GROUP BY
    island,
    year
ORDER BY
    island,
    year;
```

SELECT
    sex,
    AVG(bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill_length_mm
FROM penguins
WHERE sex IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sex;

SELECT species
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species
ORDER BY AVG(flipper_length_mm) DESC
LIMIT 1;

```sql
SELECT
    species,
    MIN(bill_depth_mm) AS min_bill_depth_mm,
    MAX(bill_depth_mm) AS max_bill_depth_mm
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species
ORDER BY species;
```

SELECT island
FROM penguins
GROUP BY island
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

```sql
SELECT
    species,
    sex,
    AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass_g
FROM penguins
WHERE sex IS NOT NULL AND sex <> ''
GROUP BY species, sex
ORDER BY species, sex;
```

```sql
SELECT
    species,
    ABS(avg_male - avg_female) AS mass_gap
FROM (
    SELECT
        species,
        AVG(CASE WHEN sex = 'male' THEN body_mass_g END) AS avg_male,
        AVG(CASE WHEN sex = 'female' THEN body_mass_g END) AS avg_female
    FROM penguins
    WHERE sex IN ('male', 'female')
    GROUP BY species
) AS sub
ORDER BY mass_gap DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

SELECT COUNT(*) AS heavier_than_species_average
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           AVG(body_mass_g) OVER (PARTITION BY species) AS species_avg_mass
    FROM penguins
) sub
WHERE body_mass_g > species_avg_mass;

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN species = 'Gentoo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS gentoo_percentage
FROM penguins
WHERE island = 'Biscoe';

```sql
SELECT
    species,
    year,
    COUNT(*) AS penguin_count
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species, year
ORDER BY species, year;
```

SELECT island
FROM penguins
GROUP BY island
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT species) > 1;

SELECT
    species,
    AVG(bill_length_mm / bill_depth_mm) AS avg_bill_length_to_depth_ratio
FROM penguins
WHERE bill_length_mm IS NOT NULL
  AND bill_depth_mm IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY species;

SELECT
    species,
    island,
    body_mass_g
FROM penguins
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC) = 1;

SELECT
    species,
    AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2007 THEN body_mass_g END) AS avg_body_mass_2007,
    AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2009 THEN body_mass_g END) AS avg_body_mass_2009
FROM penguins
WHERE year IN (2007, 2009)
GROUP BY species;

```sql
SELECT
    species,
    island
FROM (
    SELECT
        species,
        island,
        AVG(flipper_length_mm) AS avg_flipper_length
    FROM penguins
    GROUP BY species, island
) AS per_group
WHERE avg_flipper_length > (
    SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins
);
```

```sql
SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_bill_length DESC) AS rank,
    species,
    avg_bill_length
FROM (
    SELECT
        species,
        AVG(bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill_length
    FROM penguins
    GROUP BY species
) AS species_avg
ORDER BY rank;
```

SELECT
    species,
    STDDEV_POP(body_mass_g) AS body_mass_stddev
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species;
